facts.subject: Are you available for a quick call?
facts.bodyText: Hi, are you available for a quick call before the board meeting? I want to go over the new bus routes with you. Call my office line whenever you have ten minutes. Thanks, Jordan Okafor, Superintendent

facts.subject: Coffee for the morning meeting
facts.bodyText: Could you pick up coffee and pastries for tomorrow's 7:30 staff meeting? Use the school purchasing card in the main office and give the receipt to Dana. Thank you! Avery

facts.subject: Reminder: payroll changes cutoff
facts.bodyText: Hello staff, direct deposit or tax withholding changes made in ADP after the 10th take effect the following pay period. Payroll staff cannot make these changes for you by email. Payroll Office

facts.subject: We are moving to a new invoicing system
facts.bodyText: Dear customer, starting next month you will receive invoices from our new billing system, sent from this same address. Our remittance details have not changed and nothing is needed from you. Thank you for your business. Harbor Printing

facts.subject: Closing scheduled for Friday at 10 AM
facts.bodyText: Hello, your closing is scheduled for Friday at 10 AM at our Main Street office. Please bring a photo ID. We will never send wiring instructions by email; if you receive any, call us at the number on your contract before doing anything. Lakeside Title

facts.subject: Please DocuSign: Lease renewal 2027
facts.bodyText: Riverbend Apartments sent you a document to review and sign. Please review the lease renewal for unit 4B. Do not share this email; it contains a secure link to DocuSign.

facts.subject: New sign-in to your Microsoft account
facts.bodyText: We noticed a new sign-in to your Microsoft account. Country/region: United States. Platform: Windows. Browser: Edge. If this was you, you can safely ignore this email. If not, review your recent activity.

facts.subject: You sent a payment
facts.bodyText: You sent $24.00 USD to Corner Bakery. It may take a few moments for this transaction to appear in your account. Questions? Go to the Help Center.

facts.subject: You have 2 new messages in Teams
facts.bodyText: Casey Novak sent a message in Grade 6 Team: can we move planning to Wednesday? Open Teams to reply.

facts.subject: New voicemail from extension 2214
facts.bodyText: You have a new voicemail from extension 2214, 0:42 long, received at 10:15 AM. Listen to it from your desk phone or the voicemail app.

facts.subject: Student job: library circulation desk
facts.bodyText: The library is hiring three students for the circulation desk, 8 to 12 hours a week, $15 an hour. Apply on Handshake by Friday. Interviews are in person at the library.

facts.subject: Family night: RSVP
facts.bodyText: Join us for family game night on the 14th! Scan the QR code on the flyer or reply to this email to RSVP.

facts.subject: Ticket 4471 resolved: projector in room 12
facts.bodyText: Your ticket has been resolved: the projector lamp was replaced. If the problem comes back, reply to this email to reopen the ticket.

facts.subject: Annual training due Friday
facts.bodyText: Reminder: the annual blood-borne pathogens and mandated reporter trainings are due Friday. Log in with your usual district account. Thank you, Human Resources

facts.subject: Re: lunch order
facts.bodyText: I paid for the team lunch today, it came to $11 each. Pay me back whenever, cash or Venmo is fine. Riley

facts.subject: New storage limits for district accounts
facts.bodyText: Google is changing storage for school accounts. Staff accounts will have 100 GB starting in August. Most of you use far less; we will contact anyone who is over the limit directly. No action is needed.

facts.subject: Confidential: meeting request
facts.bodyText: Hello, I would like to meet with you about a personnel matter. Could you come to the HR office at 3:30 on Thursday? Please let me know if that time does not work. Morgan Fischer, Director of Human Resources

facts.subject: Board packet posted for Tuesday
facts.bodyText: The agenda and packet for Tuesday's regular board meeting are posted in BoardDocs. Executive session begins at 6 PM.

facts.subject: Your password expires in 7 days
facts.bodyText: Your district password expires in 7 days. Change it on any school computer by pressing Ctrl+Alt+Delete and choosing Change a password. IT will never ask for your password.

facts.subject: Your Amazon Business order has shipped
facts.bodyText: Your order of 12 boxes of dry-erase markers has shipped and arrives Thursday. Track your package in Your Orders.

facts.subject: Your tax appointment on March 3
facts.bodyText: This is a reminder of your appointment on March 3 at 4 PM. Please bring your W-2 and last year's return. We never ask for documents by email; bring them in person or use our office drop box.

facts.subject: Your registration is confirmed
facts.bodyText: Thank you for registering for the fall conference. Your registration and payment of $185 are confirmed. Badges are picked up at the registration desk.

facts.subject: Thank you for your gift
facts.bodyText: Thank you for your donation of $50 to the holiday meal drive. This letter is your receipt for tax purposes; no goods or services were provided in exchange.

facts.subject: Field trip permission tracker
facts.bodyText: Taylor Brennan shared a spreadsheet with you. Field trip permission tracker. Can you mark the slips you collected in your homeroom?
